title: More than one, and how many

sections.title: Plural and numbers
sections.content: A shop has many of each thing. For more than one add *-k*, with a linking vowel after a consonant: *póló → pólók*, *cipő → cipők*, *nadrág → nadrágok*, *kabát → kabátok*, *ing → ingek*. After a number or *sok* (many) the noun stays singular: *két kabát*, *sok cipő*.

sections.title: In the shop
sections.content: *Bolt → boltban* (in the shop), *ruhabolt → ruhaboltban*. A plural subject takes a plural adjective: *A pólók olcsók.* (The T-shirts are cheap.)

items.english: There are many coats in the shop.

sections.content: *Sok kabát van*, not *sok kabátok*: after *sok* and numbers the noun stays singular, as with *két kávé*.
